## Checklist

- [ ] No peer layer now depends on another peer layer
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] `syzygy.yml` unchanged, or updated to match the schema in `engineering/schema/syzygy.schema.json`
- [ ] CI passes on this pull request
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, keys or personal data in the diff, tests or fixtures
- [ ] Lock files follow the lockfile policy (library: no `Package.resolved` or `pubspec.lock`)
- [ ] For a release branch: version bumped everywhere the release standard lists, and the tag will be bare semver
